title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: every tick of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps is an instance of a Lean theorem
text: Of the ticks outside the two chain families, most turn out to be the families' smallest cases (blocks of length 2 or 3). The 42 others need seven more turn shapes, proved for chains of any length. A check compares each of the 30,931 ticks of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps with the end tape of its theorem: 30,673 chain-rule instances, 0 mismatches, and the other 258 are the left-end ticks, already proved.
